bio: Afternoon Tea Awards 2023 - 'Award of Excellence'  Afternoon Tea is quite an event at The Chesterfield Mayfair Hotel. Recognised for their outstanding quality and consistently high standards of tea service, this elegant venue pays suitable respect to the great British ritual while offering some exciting variations on the original.  Afternoon Tea is served in either their Conservatory, which is flooded with natural daylight, set against the backdrop of the garden and fountain, or the elegant Butler's Restaurant which is warm and intimate and provides a quintessential British dining experience.  The Chesterfield Hotel's latest menu is the Original Sweetshop Afternoon Tea. Rediscover old favourites and traditional treats with this nostalgic menu that captures the magic of childhood trips to the sweetshop. This whimsical Afternoon Tea features theatrical smoking pink lemonade and surprising delicious sweetshop-themed cakes.  In the heart of exclusive Mayfair, the intimate Chesterfield Mayfair Hotel is a luxury hotel ideally located for taking Afternoon Tea when shopping in Piccadilly, Bond Street, Regent Street or Oxford Street.
